title: MVP Epic: Temporal Elixir SDK
description: Track the minimum viable product scope to run workflows and activities end-to-end using Temporal Core via Rustler NIFs. Includes client ops, worker polling/completion, payload conversion, and basic framework hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Able to start a workflow, run an activity with a worker, signal/query, and retrieve result using examples; all tests pass.

title: Perf: reuse runtime and avoid needless clones
description: Audit runtime and client cloning; ensure Arc reuse and minimal allocations in hot paths; add lightweight benchmarks for polling and query.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmarks show no regressions; profiling confirms reduced clones and allocations.

title: 4.1.2: Minimal Workflow execution engine (activations→completions)
description: Process coresdk WorkflowActivation into WorkflowActivationCompletion with a minimal command set (activities, signals, complete/fail). Provide deterministic execution constraints and replay-safe state. Integrate with Worker GenServer and NIF completion APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a simple workflow module, worker processes activations and completes them; can schedule an activity and handle its result; end-to-end test passes with Temporal server.

title: Bug: Client opts mismatch (:target_url vs :host)
description: Temporal.Client.start_link docs/examples use :target_url while config expects :host; :target_url is ignored. Alias :target_url to :host in opts_to_cfg, keep :host canonical. Add unit test and update examples/docs.
acceptance_criteria: Both :host and :target_url work; example uses a consistent key; unit tests pass.

title: Bug: Protobuf JSON mode uses base64 in data field (nonstandard)
description: ProtobufConverter JSON mode sets encoding=proto/json but stores base64 in data, not canonical JSON per google/protobuf JSON mapping. Decide supported mode: stick to proto/binary for MVP; if proto/json is kept, implement true JSON mapping or drop mode. Update tests accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Either proto/json removed/flagged experimental OR implemented per protobuf JSON spec; tests updated.

title: Bug: Elixir converters' encoding strings may not match Core expectations
description: Encodings used: json/plain, binary/plain, binary/null, proto/binary. Verify against Temporal cross-SDK conventions (often 'json/plain' and 'binary/plain' are okay, but confirm 'binary/null'). Adjust to match other SDKs to ensure server-side features and interop work.
acceptance_criteria: Encoding metadata verified/standardized; round-trip with Python/Go across signal/query succeeds.

title: Bug: Native term_to_payload accepts string data for binary payloads
description: term_to_payload() treats Elixir string as bytes when data key is string; this may corrupt non-binary data. Restrict to binaries and Vec<u8>; reject plain strings unless explicitly intended. Tighten decoding and add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Only binaries are accepted for payload.data; invalid types produce {:error, ...}; tests pass.

title: Bug: client_connect returns bare resource or {:ok, res} inconsistently
description: Client NIF returns ResourceArc directly (bare reference) in some examples, while Elixir Client expects {:ok, ref} pattern sometimes. Standardize NIF return: always {:ok, resource} or always resource; update Elixir wrappers accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Return shape consistent; Client.connect handles one standard; examples/tests updated.

title: Bug: Worker polling returns custom structs not protobuf
description: worker_poll_workflow_task/activity return NifStructs with ad-hoc JSON fields; should be coresdk protobuf bytes or matching structs. Until 3.1.2.1 is done, mark as bug to avoid accidental API lock-in.
acceptance_criteria: Polling returns protobuf-serialized data; Elixir decode layer added; examples/tests consume new format.}

title: Bug: WorkerResource::convert_workflow_activation fabricates fields
description: convert_workflow_activation sets previous_started_event_id=0, attempt=1, and serializes partial activation info; this can mislead higher layers. After protobuf switch, remove fabricated fields; in interim, document clearly or rename fields to avoid confusion.
acceptance_criteria: No fabricated fields in public API; after protobuf format, fields mirror coresdk.

title: Bug: PayloadConverter default chain mismatch between Elixir and NIF
description: Elixir default chain: nil, protobuf, binary, json; NIF CompositeConverter::default: nil, binary, json (no protobuf). Align chains or pass Elixir-configured chain into NIF where needed (queries).
acceptance_criteria: Single authoritative chain configured (client config) and used for NIF query decoding; tests verify protobuf query results decode.}

title: 3.1.3: Implement Task Completion NIFs (workflow/activity)
description: Implement worker_complete_workflow_task and worker_complete_activity_task in native/temporal_nif/src/lib.rs and worker.rs. Accept protobuf (WorkflowActivationCompletion, ActivityTaskCompletion) or structured maps; send to Core and handle errors. Add integration tests to complete a no-op activation and activity.
acceptance_criteria: Can complete a polled workflow activation and activity task successfully; integration tests assert end-to-end completion.

title: Bug: Client.normalize_* silently drops converter errors
description: Client.normalize_* maps input via Temporal.PayloadConverter.to_payloads but on {:error,_} returns empty list, losing user data silently. Should surface error to caller. Fix and add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Converter errors propagate to {:error, ...}; no silent data loss; tests updated.}

title: Bug: Native JSON depth and atom handling diverge from Elixir JSON converter
description: Rust converter mentions 32-level depth but Elixir converter enforces it; ensure any future NIF-side to_payloads uses same limits and options (atom handling), or remove NIF-side conversion for MVP to avoid inconsistencies.
acceptance_criteria: Single source of truth for conversion; options respected consistently; tests cover deep/nested data.

title: Bug: Example basic_client uses target_url and Code.prepend_path hack
description: basic_client.exs uses :target_url (wrong key) and manipulates code path; switch to mix run examples and correct option key; ensure examples compile/run reliably.
acceptance_criteria: Examples run via mix run examples/*.exs with correct keys; no path hacks.}

title: 3.1.2.1: Switch polling to protobuf wire format
description: Return serialized coresdk WorkflowActivation and ActivityTask protobuf bytes from worker_poll_* NIFs; add Elixir decode helpers under lib/temporal/protobuf/. Update examples/tests accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Polling returns protobuf bytes; Elixir decodes to structs; tests updated and passing.

title: 2.2.3: Composite PayloadConverter parity incl. protobuf
description: Finalize converter chain: ensure metadata fields (encoding, messageType, messageTypeUrl, sdk) match cross-SDK expectations; integrate with NIF for from_payload in query results and to_payloads passthrough for client ops; property tests for round-trip.
acceptance_criteria: Default chain [:nil,:protobuf,:binary,:json] works; query results decode; start/signal/query accept Elixir-produced payloads; property tests pass.

title: 3.2.1: Temporal.Worker GenServer with polling loops
description: Implement OTP worker process that manages NIF worker resource, runs polling loops for workflow/activity, dispatches tasks to handlers, and integrates telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Worker runs under a Supervisor, polls continuously, processes tasks concurrently, and can be stopped cleanly; telemetry events emitted.

title: 4.1.1: Workflow behaviour and registration
description: Define Temporal.Workflow behaviour and __using__ macro, with deterministic constraints and type name derivation; provide registration mapping for worker.
acceptance_criteria: Workflows can be defined via use Temporal.Workflow; registration validated; type names derived; unit tests pass.

title: 4.2.1: Activity behaviour, context, heartbeats
description: Define Temporal.Activity behaviour and registration; expose activity context and implement heartbeat and cancellation stubs through NIFs (follow-up to completion NIFs).
acceptance_criteria: Activities execute via worker; heartbeat API available; cancellation respected; unit tests for context/heartbeat.

title: 5.1: Expand tests incl. property and integration
description: Add StreamData property tests for converters; extend integration to verify start/signal/query and end-to-end worker run with a simple workflow once completion NIFs exist.
acceptance_criteria: Property tests pass; integration suite runs green locally with Docker; coverage improved.

title: Hardening: TLS paths and error sanitization
description: Tighten TLS file path validation, handle inline certs consistently, and sanitize NIF error strings; add tests for failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid paths rejected; inline PEMs supported; error messages sanitized; tests pass.
